categories.because: The AI boundary is provider-neutral, capability-driven and configured without active provider credentials.
evidence: AI Service runtime and registries exist

categories.label: Platform Constitution & Integrity
categories.because: Platform Constitution is executable and all registered integrity rules pass before packaging.

categories.because: The shared context boundary is channel-neutral, domain-neutral, TTL-bound and rejects direct personal-data fields by default.
evidence: No persistent identity profile or cross-channel identity linking

manual_review.label: Visuelt layout og overflow
manual_review.why_manual: Runtime-koden kan opdage overflow i browseren, men denne release blev ikke kørt i et fuldt browser-CI-miljø under pakningen.
manual_review.success_criteria: Ingen kort, tekster eller knapper går uden for deres containere på desktop eller mobil.
manual_review.test_instruction: Åbn Mission Control ved normal desktopbredde og smal mobilbredde. Runtime self-test markerer teknisk overflow, mens du bekræfter den visuelle balance.

manual_review.label: Recommendation clarity
manual_review.why_manual: Naturalness and usefulness of Danish wording require human judgement.
manual_review.success_criteria: The recommendation is understandable, honest about limited evidence and does not imply automatic action.
manual_review.test_instruction: Read the English-language recommendation and confirm the reason, limitation and actions are clear.

manual_review.label: Workflow usability
manual_review.why_manual: A browser smoke test can verify routing, but not whether the workflow feels intuitive.
manual_review.success_criteria: You can return to AI Workspace and understand the next action without explanation.
manual_review.test_instruction: Open Recommendations and Release Governance, then return to AI Workspace.

manual_review.label: Returposition i rigtig browser
manual_review.why_manual: Den faktiske scroll-position afhænger af browserens navigation og dynamiske rendering.
manual_review.success_criteria: Browserens tilbageknap gendanner positionen, og det eksplicitte tilbage-link lander ved den gemte position eller AI Workspace.
manual_review.test_instruction: Scroll til AI Workspace, åbn et kort, gå tilbage med både browserknap og sidens link.

self_assessment.complexity_assessment: Behaviour contracts are declarative and reuse existing registries and test runners; new features extend the model without bespoke release logic.
known_limitations: Visual balance and wording naturalness still require the listed human review.
No analytics source is connected, so language recommendation confidence remains hypothesis-based.

engineering_assessment.because: All registered capabilities resolve, dependencies are valid, no undeclared technical debt exists, and release evidence is complete.
manual_review: Confirm that the architecture explanation is understandable to a non-developer.
